questions.q: Which gas is released when zinc reacts with dilute sulphuric acid?
questions.explanation: Zn + H₂SO₄ → ZnSO₄ + H₂↑. The gas burns with a 'pop' sound.

questions.q: CaO + H₂O → Ca(OH)₂ is an example of which type of reaction?
questions.explanation: Two reactants combine to form a single product, so it is a combination reaction (and it is exothermic).

questions.q: What colour change is seen when an iron nail is dipped in copper sulphate solution?
questions.explanation: Iron displaces copper: Fe + CuSO₄ → FeSO₄ + Cu. Blue CuSO₄ turns pale green FeSO₄.

questions.q: Burning of natural gas is an example of which type of reaction?
questions.explanation: Combustion releases heat, so it is exothermic.

questions.q: The black coating formed on heated copper powder is of:
Silver chloride turns grey in sunlight because:
options: It decomposes into silver and chlorine

questions.q: Heating lead nitrate gives brown fumes of which gas?
questions.explanation: 2Pb(NO₃)₂ → 2PbO + 4NO₂ + O₂. Brown fumes are nitrogen dioxide.

questions.q: Which of these helps prevent rancidity of food?
questions.explanation: Antioxidants (or packing in nitrogen) slow the oxidation of fats and oils.
